description.p: Jotilla is a lightweight native sticky-notes application. It keeps notes in plain UTF-8 text files with INI metadata, so your data stays readable and portable without a database.

ul.li: Autosaving sticky notes with rich text formatting
Archive browser with search, tags and calendar filtering
Custom colour palettes and opacity control
Always-on-top notes on X11 and XWayland
File-based storage with no bundled runtime

description.p: Parity with Jotilla 1.10.0: per-note and default scrollable text with hidden scrollbars, paste overflow notices, tray recall of the last note, and the shared Windows/macOS archive format.
